tools.name: begin_session
tools.description: Start private trip context. Optional recovery question plus secret phrase (12+ chars), never personal facts.

tools.name: get_session
tools.description: Read only this guest's saved trip and operation IDs using the private token; ID alone grants no access.

tools.name: update_session
tools.description: Merge newly answered trip fields into this guest's saved context.

tools.name: set_recovery_question
tools.description: Enable/change private recovery after starting a trip. Requires the current session token; no plaintext answer is stored.

tools.name: get_recovery_question
tools.description: Return only the configured recovery question, no guest trip/contact/booking details.

tools.name: recover_session
tools.description: Recover a known session using the secret answer, max 5 attempts/hour. Rotates/revokes the previous session token.

tools.name: list_hotels
tools.description: Search/paginate the imported Bnovo catalog. Unresolved ID records are explicitly labelled, not invented hotel names.

tools.name: get_hotel_info
tools.description: Read public room types and regular plans of one allowlisted hotel.

tools.name: search_rooms
tools.description: Live offers for the saved trip across at most 10 chosen/identified hotels. Partial supplier failures remain visible.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Recheck selected hotel/room/plan and bind a 5-minute quote to this guest's saved trip.

tools.name: create_booking
tools.description: Create one real supplier reservation after explicit consent. Requires secure client access and private guest session.

tools.name: get_booking
tools.description: Read only a booking attached to this private guest session. Last recorded result, not a fresh PMS/payment assertion.

tools.name: create_booking_link
tools.description: Return the selected hotel's own booking form. Does not reserve or pay.
